summary: The Iron Snail is Michael's men's clothing and gear channel, known for in-depth reviews, comparisons and rankings of boots, raw and selvedge denim, waxed and wool jackets, down jackets and t-shirts, often with hands-on water, shrink and wear tests. Alongside reviewing other brands, he runs his own label, The Iron Snail, which makes products such as the Mammoth wool jacket and the Prologue jacket and works with heritage makers on collaborations.

journey.title: Boot reviews with waterproof tests
journey.text: The channel reviewed heritage boots such as Blundstones, pairing first impressions on construction and comfort with hands-on water resistance tests.

citations.quote: The Blundstone 550's in rustic brown is certainly an attractive boot, but does it live up to the hype?

journey.title: Getting into raw denim
journey.text: Michael described moving from jackets into raw denim and documented shrinking and wearing Levi's 501 STF jeans, a topic that became a recurring theme.

citations.quote: recently I started to get into denim jackets and then that naturally led to getting raw denim jeans

journey.title: Iron Snail Prologue jacket orders
journey.text: By late 2022 The Iron Snail was taking orders for its Prologue jackets, with Michael updating customers on a delivery delay.

citations.quote: the iron snail prologue jackets are delayed until mid-February

journey.title: Seasonal 'Olympics' comparison format
journey.text: He started themed seasonal comparisons such as the 'Waxed Jacket Olympics', breaking jackets down by specs, sizing, accolades, cons and who should wear them.

citations.quote: today on the wax jacket Olympics we will be looking at four wax jackets

journey.title: Second channel launched
journey.text: A vlog channel, The Tale of The Iron Snail, was announced and went live.

citations.quote: NEW CHANNEL (sorry for the posting delay): @TheTaleofTheIronSnail
the second channel the tail the iron snail the Vlog channel is officially live

journey.title: Mammoth jacket launch
journey.text: Michael presented The Iron Snail Mammoth wool jacket alongside Filson and WeatherWool and opened pre-orders.

citations.quote: THE MAMMOTH IS HERE: theironsnail.us

journey.title: Community-voted rankings
journey.text: He began 'Internet's Favorite' rankings built from viewer votes, tallying comments to decide which brands to test.

citations.quote: I downloaded all of your comments on my last t-shirt video and tallied the most mentioned brands that I didn't include

journey.title: Expanding the Iron Snail product line
journey.text: From the studio, Michael showed in-development Iron Snail products, including the brand's made-in-USA selvedge denim and new samples.

citations.quote: to see the first ever Iron Snail made in USA salvage denim
Iron snail update HQ

ventures.title: The Iron Snail Mammoth Jacket
ventures.text: A made-in-America, double-layered 28 oz wool jacket with a worsted wool lining and 'wind wall' construction, priced at $550 at launch, with a special edition in Scottish wool and a later V3 version in development.

citations.quote: the mammoth body fabric is made out of 28 o wool and it's double layered
This is the Mammoth V3 that is coming out later this year in black, in blue, and buffalo plaid
